problem_text:
A regional sales representative must conduct in-person meetings across nine corporate branch offices.

The travel durations between offices are measured in minutes:
* Office 1 to Office 2: 136.2 minutes
* Office 1 to Office 3: 92.3 minutes
* Office 1 to Office 4: 24.2 minutes
* Office 1 to Office 5: 78.2 minutes
* Office 1 to Office 6: 120.4 minutes
* Office 1 to Office 7: 97.9 minutes
* Office 1 to Office 8: 87.6 minutes
* Office 1 to Office 9: 66.2 minutes
* Office 2 to Office 3: 164.4 minutes
* Office 2 to Office 4: 160.3 minutes
* Office 2 to Office 5: 121.7 minutes
* Office 2 to Office 6: 193.9 minutes
* Office 2 to Office 7: 193.1 minutes
* Office 2 to Office 8: 172.0 minutes
* Office 2 to Office 9: 101.1 minutes
* Office 3 to Office 4: 93.1 minutes
* Office 3 to Office 5: 165.6 minutes
* Office 3 to Office 6: 31.8 minutes
* Office 3 to Office 7: 33.6 minutes
* Office 3 to Office 8: 13.6 minutes
* Office 3 to Office 9: 65.0 minutes
* Office 4 to Office 5: 93.6 minutes
* Office 4 to Office 6: 117.2 minutes
* Office 4 to Office 7: 90.2 minutes
* Office 4 to Office 8: 85.2 minutes
* Office 4 to Office 9: 83.6 minutes
* Office 5 to Office 6: 195.9 minutes
* Office 5 to Office 7: 175.8 minutes
* Office 5 to Office 8: 163.5 minutes
* Office 5 to Office 9: 116.8 minutes
* Office 6 to Office 7: 32.0 minutes
* Office 6 to Office 8: 32.8 minutes
* Office 6 to Office 9: 96.1 minutes
* Office 7 to Office 8: 21.8 minutes
* Office 7 to Office 9: 92.0 minutes
* Office 8 to Office 9: 71.2 minutes

The objective is to determine the itinerary of minimal total duration that visits every branch office precisely once, concluding the circuit back at the initial office.
